About

I specialize in end-to-end web and mobile experiences — editorial web layouts, complex data systems, and task-focused mobile app interfaces, built in Figma from first sketch to shipped screen.

Selected work

Home & destination detail — Gandikota, “The Grand Canyon of India”

01 — Editorial · Web

Andhra Hidden Trails

An editorial travel guide built around six places in Andhra Pradesh that sit outside the tourist circuit — documented as a field journal for the budget traveler who prefers discovery over comfort. The layout borrows from print magazine conventions: a masthead, a running photo column, and pull-quote typography instead of a conventional nav-and-hero template.

Onboarding & doctors list — nearest, rated, fee up front

02 — Mobile · Healthcare

TravelCare

A healthcare app for people traveling abroad, built around one problem: getting sick far from home shouldn't mean gambling on an unfamiliar system. TravelCare surfaces verified doctors and transparent consultation pricing up front, with multi-language support so the first screen a traveler sees is reassurance, not a wall of forms.
